css:
a[href="/"],
a[href="/explore/"],
a[href="/explore"],
a[href^="/explore/"],
a[href="/reels/"],
a[href="/reels"],
a[href^="intent:"],
a[href^="instagram://"],
a[href*="itunes.apple.com"],
a[href*="play.google.com"],
a[href*="app_install"],
[aria-label="Open Instagram"],
[aria-label="Open in app"],
[aria-label="Get the app"],
[aria-label="Install app"] {
  display: none !important;
}
/* The inbox list's Back arrow leads to the feed; conversations keep theirs. */
html[data-onlydm-route^="/direct/inbox"] svg[aria-label="Back"],
html[data-onlydm-route^="/direct/inbox"] a:has(svg[aria-label="Back"]),
html[data-onlydm-route^="/direct/inbox"] [role="button"]:has(svg[aria-label="Back"]),
html[data-onlydm-route^="/direct/inbox"] button:has(svg[aria-label="Back"]) {
  display: none !important;
}
